title: What the live paper record shows

body:

Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for trend-daily-v005 and from 9 October 2026 for trend-daily-v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-15T21:11:20.634Z.

- ATOM result: ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- NEAR: a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.
- Expectation: in testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.
- One trade says nothing about a strategy.
